_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_raised: validate.py 1647 -> 1788: the fifteenth pack adds its structural, enumeration, kit-parity and mirror checks, plus seven reciprocal fork edges (manpage forks against blueprint, datasheet, field-notes, instrument-console, scoreboard, showroom and workbench, and each now links back). validate_palette.py 716 -> 791: manpage declares two themes whose ratios and every stated claim are recomputed on every run -- and the stated-ratio checker earned its keep twice on this pack, catching --ink-strong claimed at 18.98:1 against a computed 19.44 and --on-action-strong at 6.71:1 against 7.76. sloplint.py 366 -> 422: one more pack and token layer under the bans.
